test.title: A place near water, such as a river, lake or sea, that you enjoyed visiting

document.cue: Describe a place near water, such as a river, lake or sea, that you enjoyed visiting.

text: The place I'd like to describe is Lake Kaindy, which is in the mountains about three hours' drive from Almaty. I went there two summers ago with a group of friends from university, and it's still one of the most unusual places I've ever seen.

The lake was formed about a hundred years ago after an earthquake caused a landslide, and a whole forest of fir trees was flooded. Today the tops of the dead trees still stick out of the water, which is an incredible turquoise colour, so it looks almost unreal, like a scene from a fantasy film.

We set off at dawn, and the last part of the road was so rough that we had to leave the car and walk for an hour. When we finally got there, it was freezing, but a couple of us were brave enough to put our feet in the water — for about ten seconds.

What made it special was the silence. In the city there's always some noise in the background, but there you could only hear the wind and the water. For a few hours nobody checked their phone, partly because there was no signal and partly because we didn't want to.
I've been meaning to go back in autumn, when the trees around the lake turn yellow, and I'm sure it'll be just as memorable.

tips.en: Like a scene from a fantasy film lets the listener see the place at once.
